name: simem
description: Local project memory shared across every agent and account, plus tools that keep context small. Requires the simem package (the setup skill installs it).

interface.shortDescription: Project memory shared across agents and accounts
interface.longDescription: simem keeps what your agents learn about a project on your machine and shares it with every agent and account you use (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor). It also keeps noisy command output and whole-file reads out of the context. Everything stays local.
defaultPrompt: Set up simem memory for this machine
What did we decide about this project before?
How many tokens did simem save this week?
